summary: Oversized, unmanaged buffers in networks cause a range of performance problems, and Active Queue Management (AQM) schemes, sometimes combined with packet scheduling, can help. This informational document describes criteria and guidelines for characterizing and comparing AQM mechanisms, so that evaluations are done in a consistent way.

eli5.summary: If too many people line up at one doorway, the line gets huge and slow. Queue managers decide who waits and who is turned away early. This explains how to test whether a queue manager does its job well.
